name: The Fertility Ritual
source:
The Fertility Ritual is a short adult fetish visual novel, following the first meetings at a magical ritual under the winter moon where participants come to engage in accelerated pregnancy breeding sessions. There are four characters to seduce and the protagonist can be impregnated, impregnate others, or in one possible playthrough both!
